note: The lock amendments of kiwi-ui/DESIGN.md and kiwi-ui/JOURNEY.md, in the order they were made, each with its base (the commit before it) and its record, written with the amendment, never typed (record-amendment.mjs writes a new one, or rewrites the newest after more edits). check-copy.mjs L7 and L8 hold them as a chain (section 8b): each amendment from its base to the next one's base, the newest to the working tree; L1, L2, L4 and L5 read the two files at the first amendment's base. Two kinds of record, each line as the SHA-256 of its text. The first kind is scoped to one section (`design.section`): what the amendment replaces there and with what, what it inserts there, what it appends at the end of the file, and the lines it inserts in JOURNEY.md after an anchor. The second kind, a patch (`kind: "patch"`, for an amendment that edits many sections), holds each file position-exact as the hunks of a line diff from the base: `at` is where a hunk starts in the base (1-based, with every block the checker writes that `blocks` names collapsed to one line, so a rewritten block shifts no position), `removed` and `added` are the lines it takes out and puts in, and `starts` is the first 48 characters of its first line that is not blank, for a reader; no hunk means the file is unchanged.
